R-ClaimLab separates source inspection from import. Inspection exposes the
provider, files, revision, license, citation, and publication status. Import is
local, bounded, deterministic, and assigns a stable `source_record_id` to each
retained row.

```{r}
library(rclaimlab)
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv")
write.csv(iris, path, row.names = FALSE)

source <- dataset_source("local", path)
manifest <- inspect_dataset(source)
preview <- preview_dataset(source, rows = 5)
dataset <- import_dataset(source, max_rows = 100, seed = 2026)

manifest
head(dataset$source_record_id)
profile_dataset(dataset)
```

Public Hugging Face builds must identify both an immutable repository revision
and a concrete CSV, TSV, or Parquet file. The selected file is read from that
revision, while the Dataset Viewer is used for current service metadata. Kaggle
downloads use the official `kaggle` command-line client and its existing login;
R-ClaimLab never accepts or stores the token.

Remote datasets remain subject to their own licenses and citations. A
distributable build is blocked when revision or license evidence is missing.
